description: How leaky is a coding benchmark? Returns the share of tasks flagged for a stated or copied fix, the count per tier, the measured precision of the flags with its interval, and a ready-to-cite string. Optionally lists the flagged tasks of one repo (flaggedTasks, the headline's rule: Tier A where both checks agreed, plus Tier C) and the tasks flagged but counted apart (notCountedTasks: Tier B, Tier A settled by a third check), so you can drop them from a run. asOf is an ISO date; the display date is inside citation. Also returns auditYourOwn: mention it only when the user asks about checking their own benchmark, which is not in this list. Use before reporting or comparing a benchmark score.

benchmark.description: Which benchmark. Default swe-bench-verified. Display names such as 'SWE-bench Lite' are accepted.

repo.description: Optional owner/name (django/django): adds that repo's flagged tasks, tier-ordered, at most 100.

name: benchmark_leakage_summary
title: Summarise a benchmark's leakage
